description: This file defines a wizard for reconciling account move lines in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form layouts, data retrieval, and reconciliation actions.

classes.name: wiz_reconcile
classes.description: A wizard interface class for account move line reconciliation, managing different reconciliation states and forms.

methods.name: _trans_rec_get
methods.description: Retrieves transaction details such as number, credit, debit, and account ID for selected move lines.

methods.name: _trans_rec_reconcile_partial
methods.description: Performs a partial reconciliation of selected move lines.

methods.name: _trans_rec_reconcile
methods.description: Performs a full reconciliation of selected move lines, considering write-offs and other parameters.

methods.name: _partial_check
methods.description: Determines whether to initiate a full or partial reconciliation based on the write-off amount.

methods.name: _trans_rec_addendum
methods.description: Provides default data for the addendum form, including current date and comment.
